messages:
Sara: quick sync — we need to land a retention-tiering plan for telemetry that also preserves correct cost attribution. thinking: hot(0-24h), warm(1-30d), cold(31-365d).
Leo: +1 to tiers. main tradeoff is where we stop carrying billing keys and span-level attrs. cold storage should be aggregated-only to avoid cost explosion.
Mira: question: do we transform at the gateway (edge) or in the enrichment pipeline? gateway = lower egress but more coupling to ingest contract.
Devin: gateway adds risk to SDKs/clients. prefer doing a lightweight normalize at the gateway then full shape in enrichment workers.
Sara: agreed. proposal: gateway strips heavy payloads (full logs, large attachments), keeps span envelope + billing_key, trace_id, service, latency, and writes to hot topic. enrichment layer enriches, duplicates to warm/cold with further downsampling.
Leo: for cold we should only keep rollups: per-trace flags, service/day cost buckets, minimal tag set. Avoid keeping raw spans.
Mira: how do we handle sampling and billing attribution? If we sample at gateway, we lose per-request cost mapping. We could keep a lightweight billing footprint record even for sampled-out spans. e.g.:
```
{ trace_id, billing_key, tokens_estimate, timestamp }
```
Sara: yes — keep a tiny billing footprint record forwarded regardless of sampling. That record is what billing aggregates against. raw spans can be dropped after warm retention.
infra-bot: deploy:ingest-gateway:v2 started by @Devin — rolling update 3/5 nodes (info).
Devin: infra-bot ^^ see above. prototyping the billing-footprint message now. pushing a shim to the kafka->s3 sink so cold tier gets rollups only.
Leo: implementation note: make the billing footprint schema stable and small. Add a version field so we can evolve without breaking billing jobs.
Mira: tests — we need an e2e that shows cost parity (billing from footprints) vs current raw-span billing. create a dataset with mixed sampling and validate monthly totals.
Sara: action items: @Leo to draft footprint schema and compatibility rules (T+3d), @Devin to add sink shim for warm->cold transformation (T+7d), @Mira to own e2e validation harness (T+10d). I'll file the follow-up RFC and link infra tickets.
Leo: one more: consider edge-case for long-running traces (jobs >24h). probably keep them in hot/warm longer by flagging with `preserve=true` on the footprint.
Devin: noted. we'll add `preserve` and TTL override handling in enrichment.
Mira: linking existing RFC: https://docs.redwood.internal/rfcs/telemetry-tiering (for context).
Sara: ok let's reconvene after initial schema PRs. thanks all :thumbsup:
